ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
signaling_summary: ISO/IEC 14443 is fundamentally an analog/mixed-signal protocol because Layer 2 is an RF air interface. The PCD generates a 13.56 MHz unmodulated carrier at field strength H within Hmin (1.5 A/m) and Hmax (7.5 A/m); Type A PCD→PICC bits are 100% ASK Modified-Miller pulses (pause durations 2.0..3.0 μs); Type B uses 10% ASK NRZ-L. The PICC harvests power from the carrier, demodulates the envelope, and replies by switching a load resistor in/out of the resonant antenna at the 847.5 kHz subcarrier rate (Manchester for Type A, BPSK for Type B). All digital framing — bits, parity, CRC — is layered on top of this analog substrate.

voltage_classes.applicable_modes: All ISO 14443 PICCs — voltage is induced, not external.
Powers the PCD oscillator, modulator, receiver.

voltage_classes.p_p_V_typical: ≈ 2× (1.5 .. 100) at antenna depending on Q and field strength
voltage_classes.applicable_modes: Antenna-port voltage envelope at the PCD's matching network.
Rectified + regulated; only valid while field is present.

type_a_pcd_to_picc_modulation.modulation_coding: Modified Miller — bit 1 = pause in second half of ETU; bit 0 = pause depends on preceding bit (no pause after 0-after-0; pause at start of ETU after 1-then-0 transitions; pause in middle after 0-then-1).

type_a_picc_to_pcd_load_modulation.modulation_index_min_mV_peak: 22 / sqrt(H) (at minimum field) — actual minimum amplitude of the modulation product detected at the PCD's reference antenna.
type_a_picc_to_pcd_load_modulation.coding: Manchester — bit 1 = subcarrier ON in first half ETU + OFF in second half; bit 0 = OFF first half + ON second half (or vice-versa, depending on PICC reference).

type_b_pcd_to_picc_modulation.modulation_coding: NRZ-L — high amplitude carrier = bit 1, lower amplitude = bit 0; each ETU carries one bit.

type_b_picc_to_pcd_load_modulation.coding: BPSK — subcarrier phase 0° = bit 1, phase 180° = bit 0; phase reference established during SOF.

minimum_field_strength_for_picc_operatio.operating_volume_mm: Class 1 antennas: 100 mm × 60 mm reference area; Class 2/3/4 are reduced-footprint per ISO 10373-6.

notes: The PICC analog front-end is a passive rectifier + shunt regulator + envelope detector + load-switch modulator with no analog trim register exposed to the air interface — vendor-specific charge-pump trim, antenna-resonance trim, and Q-factor calibration are wafer-test programmed into the IC's internal OTP and are not visible to the PCD over RF. The PCD analog requirement is far more elaborate (oscillator, PA, matching network, envelope detector, subcarrier demodulator, ADC, EMI mask) and is documented in PCD-vendor datasheets (e.g. NXP CLRC663 / PN512 / PN5180) rather than in AN10833 itself.
evidence_in_an10833: Section 1.3: 'The ISO/IEC 14443-2 defines the carrier frequency of 13.56 MHz, the modulation, and the bit coding'
Section 1.3: identifies that AN10833 itself focuses on protocol-layer identification, leaving Layer 2 analog details to ISO 14443-2.
